title: MaterialCompatibilityContract
description: Schema for evaluating heritage material compatibility against candidate conservation interventions (Kirti Antil). Distinguishes inferred photo-based material hypotheses from lab-verified testing.

original_material.description: Identified or inferred original historic substrate (e.g. lime_mortar_hydraulic, sandstone_dholpur, basalt_rubble, quartzite_ashlar, lakhori_brick)

original_material_confidence.description: Confidence of photographic/contextual material identification. Must reflect that photo-identification is probabilistic.

verification_required.description: True if laboratory material characterization (e.g. petrography, XRD, binder-aggregate ratio) is mandatory before physical intervention.

recommended_tests.description: Recommended on-site or lab testing procedures to verify substrate composition.

candidate_interventions.description: Evaluated intervention options (e.g. slaked_lime_putty, surkhi_lime_mortar, opc_portland_cement, acrylic_sealant)

intervention_material.description: Candidate mortar, grout, or conservation consolidant

mechanical.description: Elastic modulus matching, compressive strength compatibility (avoiding over-strength)

chemical.description: Chemical inertness, absence of deleterious salts (e.g. sulfates, alkali)

reversibility.description: Degree to which intervention can be removed without damaging original fabric

heritage.description: Alignment with traditional IKS construction methods and authentic regional recipes

visual.description: Texture, color, and aging compatibility with surrounding historic masonry

warnings.description: Critical alerts regarding risks (e.g., trapping moisture with cementitious renders)
